# 손으로 만든 예시다. dcgm-exporter 4.8 형식, MIG를 켜지 않은 A100 2장 노드.
# 수집 목록에 DCGM_FI_DEV_MIG_MODE를 넣었다. GPU 0은 XID 79, GPU 1은 llm-serve-0이 쓴다.
# NVSwitch 줄은 GPU UUID가 없어 건너뛰어야 한다.
# HELP DCGM_FI_DEV_MIG_MODE MIG mode.
# TYPE DCGM_FI_DEV_MIG_MODE gauge
DCGM_FI_DEV_MIG_MODE{gpu="0",UUID="GPU-0a1b2c3d-0000-4000-8000-000000000000",pci_bus_id="00000000:00:04.0",device="nvidia0",modelName="NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB",Hostname="gke-grim-demo-gpu-full-9a1d",container="",namespace="",pod=""} 0
DCGM_FI_DEV_MIG_MODE{gpu="1",UUID="GPU-0a1b2c3d-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",pci_bus_id="00000000:00:05.0",device="nvidia1",modelName="NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB",Hostname="gke-grim-demo-gpu-full-9a1d",container="server",namespace="ml",pod="llm-serve-0"} 0
# HELP DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS Value of the last XID error encountered.
# TYPE DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS gauge
DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS{gpu="0",UUID="GPU-0a1b2c3d-0000-4000-8000-000000000000",pci_bus_id="00000000:00:04.0",device="nvidia0",modelName="NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB",Hostname="gke-grim-demo-gpu-full-9a1d",container="",namespace="",pod=""} 79
DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS{gpu="1",UUID="GPU-0a1b2c3d-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",pci_bus_id="00000000:00:05.0",device="nvidia1",modelName="NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB",Hostname="gke-grim-demo-gpu-full-9a1d",container="server",namespace="ml",pod="llm-serve-0"} 0
